d:
Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang’s possible return as CEO has triggered a major campaign across Silicon Valley. Elon Musk, Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney and several industry figures are reportedly backing his comeback. According to the Financial Times, Huang has discussed the possibility with close associates. Meanwhile, Nvidia’s board faces questions over succession, an ongoing investigation and the company’s future leadership. With shares reportedly falling and billions in market value at stake, will Nvidia bring its legendary founder back?
